newsitem.title: USA: Spiegel cuts 125 jobs at headquarters.
newsitem.headline: Spiegel cuts 125 jobs at headquarters.

text.p: Spiegel Inc said Monday it has cut 125 jobs, or about 14 percent, at its headquarters in a bid to revitalize its flagship catalog.
The company, which has not reported an annual profit since 1994, said it unveiled the staff cuts last week. It has not ruled out more cutbacks in the future, said spokeswoman Allison Scherer.

The staff reductions were part of a reorganization aimed at bolstering the sagging Spiegel catalog. Weak results at the catalog added to a five percent drop in the company's total sales in the first quarter.
Ten days ago, Spiegel announced President and Chief Executive John Shea would retire. The company formed an office of the president, including three Spiegel executives, to replace him.
Spiegel lost $31.2 million, or $0.28 a share, in the first quarter, compared with a loss of $14.3 million, or $0.13 a share, in the same period a year earlier.
